triples.head_surface: opening of the control system assemblies or compartments
triples.head_canonical_zh: 控制系统组件或隔间开启
triples.tail_surface: inadvertent or automatic loss of propulsion
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 意外或自动丧失推进动力
triples.evidence_text: opening of the control system assemblies or compartments will not cause inadvertent or automatic loss of propulsion

triples.tail_surface: steam or oil will not come in contact with the energized parts
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 蒸汽或油接触带电部件
triples.evidence_text: steam or oil will not come in contact with the energized parts in case of leakage

triples.head_surface: disturbance, for example, in the ventilators for propulsion motors, in the converters, cooling water supply or load limitation of the generators
triples.head_canonical_zh: 推进电机通风机、变流器、冷却水供应或发电机负载限制中的扰动
triples.evidence_text: “Power limitation”: in case of disturbance, for example, in the ventilators for propulsion motors, in the converters, cooling water supply or load limitation of the generators.
